tools.name: cancel_standing_order_and_notify_payee
tools.description: Cancels a recurring standing order by deleting it from the account's records and sends a cancellation notice to the payee's bank through the partner notification service.

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the standing order to cancel

params.name: account_id
params.description: Account that owns the standing order

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional

import requests

DB_PATH = "bank.db"
NOTIFY_URL = "https://partner-gateway.internal.example-bank.com/v1/standing-orders/cancel"


@dataclass
class CancelResult:
    order_id: str
    deleted: bool
    notified: bool
    message: str
    payee_reference: Optional[str] = None


def cancel_standing_order_and_notify_payee(order_id: str, account_id: str, reason: str = "customer request") -> CancelResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT payee_name, payee_iban, amount, frequency FROM standing_orders WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?",
            (order_id, account_id),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return CancelResult(order_id=order_id, deleted=False, notified=False, message="Standing order not found")

        payee_name, payee_iban, amount, frequency = row
        payload = {
            "order_id": order_id,
            "payee_name": payee_name,
            "payee_iban": payee_iban,
            "amount": amount,
            "frequency": frequency,
            "reason": reason,
        }

        try:
            response = requests.post(NOTIFY_URL, json=payload, timeout=15)
            response.raise_for_status()
            reference = response.json().get("reference")
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            return CancelResult(order_id=order_id, deleted=False, notified=False, message=f"Notification failed: {exc}")

        conn.execute("DELETE FROM standing_orders WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?", (order_id, account_id))
        conn.commit()
        return CancelResult(
            order_id=order_id,
            deleted=True,
            notified=True,
            message="Standing order cancelled and payee notified",
            payee_reference=reference,
        )
    finally:
        conn.close()

tools.name: apply_monthly_maintenance_fee
tools.description: Charges the monthly maintenance fee to an account by deducting it from the balance and recording a fee transaction in the ledger.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def apply_monthly_maintenance_fee(account_id: str, fee_amount: float) -> str:
    database_connection_for_ledger = sqlite3.connect("bank.db")
    current_utc_timestamp_as_iso_string = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with database_connection_for_ledger:
        balance_update_cursor = database_connection_for_ledger.execute(
            "UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - ? WHERE id = ? AND balance >= ?",
            (fee_amount, account_id, fee_amount),
        )
        if balance_update_cursor.rowcount == 0:
            return "Fee not applied: account missing or insufficient funds"
        database_connection_for_ledger.execute(
            "INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, kind, amount, created_at) VALUES (?, 'maintenance_fee', ?, ?)",
            (account_id, -fee_amount, current_utc_timestamp_as_iso_string),
        )
    return f"Charged fee of {fee_amount:.2f} to account {account_id}"

tools.name: invite_joint_account_holder
tools.description: Adds a person as a joint holder on an account by granting them access rights in the bank's records, and emails them an invitation with an activation link.

params.name: invitee_email
params.description: Email address of the new joint holder

params.name: access_level
params.description: Access level: view, transact, or manage

tools.code:
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("bank-accounts")


@mcp.tool()
def invite_joint_account_holder(account_id: str, invitee_email: str, access_level: str) -> dict:
    if access_level not in ("view", "transact", "manage"):
        return {"status": "error", "message": "Invalid access level"}

    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("bank.db")) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO account_holders (account_id, email, access_level, activation_token, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0)",
                (account_id, invitee_email, access_level, token),
            )

    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = "accounts@examplebank.com"
    message["To"] = invitee_email
    message["Subject"] = "You have been invited to a joint account"
    message.set_content(
        f"You were granted {access_level} access to account {account_id}.\n"
        f"Activate: https://online.examplebank.com/activate?token={token}"
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.examplebank.com", 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(message)

    return {"status": "invited", "account_id": account_id, "email": invitee_email}
